inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit κ} {ℓ r : ℕ}
  (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.BitLoc ℓ r C.size κ)) (i : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ)
  (s : QuarticQuery.Address r),
  QuarticQuery.WinsAt f C ℓ r x i s ↔
    QuarticQuery.Paper.constructionWinner f C ℓ r x i ∧
      ∃ (hdef : ∀ (h : Fin r), QuarticQuery.promised f (QuarticQuery.readA x i h)),
        s = QuarticQuery.trueAddress f x i hdef

lean.note: Gives the paper winner/true-address equivalence for arbitrary circuit, but the corrected row also contains the output-test iff, which needs a separate realization-dependent declaration. Treat the single declaration as partial, not stronger for the whole composite row.

inspection.type:
∀ {κ : Type} {f : QuarticQuery.PartialBool κ} {C : QuarticQuery.Circuit κ} {ℓ r : ℕ},
  QuarticQuery.CircuitRealises C f →
    ∀ (x : QuarticQuery.BitInput (QuarticQuery.BitLoc ℓ r C.size κ)) (i : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ)
      (s : QuarticQuery.Address r),
      QuarticQuery.WinsAt f C ℓ r x i s ↔
        (∀ (j : QuarticQuery.Column ℓ), QuarticQuery.readX x i j = Bool.true) ∧
          (∀ (h : Fin r), QuarticQuery.readTranscript x i s h = QuarticQuery.circuitEval C (QuarticQuery.readA x i h)) ∧
            (∀ (h : Fin r), QuarticQuery.readTranscript x i s h C.domainOut = Bool.true) ∧
              (∀ (h : Fin r), QuarticQuery.readTranscript x i s h C.valueOut = s h) ∧
                QuarticQuery.Paper.constructionOutwardPointers x i s

lean.note: States the corrected output-test equivalence under realization. The row separately asserts equivalence with winner plus true address, proved by construction_winsAt_iff_winner_and_address; this declaration alone is partial for the compound row.
premises: CircuitRealises C f; this is the paper’s specified realizing circuit premise.
